guard: The test-only callout transport awaits issued release before forwarding a prepared native success, forwards signed denial on issuer failure and rejects unsupported proposed connection metadata. It reuses the unchanged callout handler and does not use onMint as authority. Production discovery and transparent reconnect are outside this proof.

mutations.name: issuer release is not awaited
mutations.expectRed: prepared callout success stays private until the awaited issuer gate completes
mutations.cell: prepared callout success stays private until the awaited issuer gate completes

mutations.name: issuer rejection forwards the prepared success
mutations.expectRed: callout generation reuse refuses instead of silently reminting
mutations.cell: callout generation reuse refuses instead of silently reminting

mutations.name: future callout metadata is accepted
mutations.expectRed: legacy and future connection metadata receive no issued fallback
mutations.cell: legacy and future connection metadata receive no issued fallback
